morning_dispatches.text: Reminder: Tractor wheel circumference exceeds nominal spec by 1.4 %. Any unauthorized harvest mileage will be billed as recreational joyriding. Warmly, Dispatch.
Your bench hygrometer's gold sticker expired at 03:00. All humidity observed since then is legally considered hearsay. Warmly, Dispatch.
Thermal scan detected eight-legged heat signatures indoors. Please confirm they are licensed productivity assets and not emotional support arthropods. Warmly, Dispatch.
Solar flare expected at noon. BNH is not liable if your mower develops free will or harvests your mailbox. Warmly, Dispatch.
Quarterly surprise inspection scheduled for Thursday. Please act surprised; our drone logs facial enthusiasm. Warmly, Dispatch.
Unregistered optical silk detected in relay dish #1. Great signal-to-noise ratio, terrible paperwork. Expect a form. Warmly, Dispatch.
Outpost loneliness is down 4 % after we reclassified talking to your rover as 'verbal diagnostics.' Warmly, Dispatch.
A neighbor reported your soil plots look 'suspiciously straight.' Prepare to prove your laser level is traceable to Orbit. Warmly, Dispatch.
Reminder: 'Eyeballing it' is not an approved uncertainty budget method under Frontier Clause 19-B. Warmly, Dispatch.
Your replacement reference weight fell off the cargo rail at 12 000 meters. Please re-zero it before use. Warmly, Dispatch.
Your steering test uncertainty ratio (TUR) fell below 4:1. The approval button has been replaced with a larger button labeled 'Are You Sure?' Warmly, Dispatch.
The rover is inside tolerance but outside our guard-banded acceptance limit. It may remain parked in the space marked 'Technically Fine.' Warmly, Dispatch.
Encoder error logged at −0.48° as found and +0.12° as left. Inspector Vance has asked that the turnip rows be given the same chance to correct themselves. Warmly, Dispatch.
Your bench hygrometer's uncertainty budget lists the reference standard, resolution and repeatability. Please add the fan you switched off for the auditor. Warmly, Dispatch.
One calibration certificate is missing from your reference hygrometer's traceability chain. We can trace the invoice all the way to Orbit. Warmly, Dispatch.
Drift history supports a shorter calibration interval. Procurement asks whether the encoder could drift more slowly until the next budget cycle. Warmly, Dispatch.
Tarantula molt logged as a second resident. Please submit a departure time for whichever spider is empty. Warmly, Dispatch.
Uplink delay climbed behind the boulder again. If you already sent reverse, give it a moment before sending reverse with feeling. Warmly, Dispatch.
Employee engagement fell 3 % after we made the morning morale survey mandatory. The survey now opens before your rover controls. Warmly, Dispatch.
Your seed order landed 5 m outside the plot. The delivery photo shows a boulder signing for it. Warmly, Dispatch.
Optical silk cleared the morning packet backlog. Your rover has now received all seven copies of 'please ignore my last command.' Warmly, Dispatch.
AUD-1T flagged a crooked sticker on its own charging dock. The dock has requested a different inspector. Warmly, Dispatch.

audit_fines.title: Unapproved Arachnid-Assisted Telemetry
audit_fines.reason: Used homegrown tarantula silk to out-perform a 40 000-credit corporate transceiver.
audit_fines.snarky_footer: Innovation without a Form 88-C is just vandalism with better tolerances.

audit_fines.title: Expired Calibration Sticker (By 4 Minutes)
audit_fines.reason: Rover steering encoder operated past its 08:00 certification window.
audit_fines.snarky_footer: Time is a precision instrument. Yours is late.

audit_fines.title: Aesthetic Crop Deviation
audit_fines.reason: Drifting tractor carved a 7-degree curve into Row 3, lowering orbital satellite photo morale.
audit_fines.snarky_footer: Please keep all frontier geometry depressing and orthogonal.

audit_fines.title: Missing Witness Signature on Solo Outpost
audit_fines.reason: Failed to have a second certified technician countersign your morning zeroing log.
audit_fines.snarky_footer: We do not accept tarantula paw prints as notarized consent.

audit_fines.title: Excessive Signal Clarity
audit_fines.reason: Satellite relay latency dropped below your paid subscription tier.
audit_fines.snarky_footer: Upgrade to Platinum Uplink or kindly re-introduce 200 ms of lag.

bram.name: Bram
greetings: Morning, Doc. Heard your tractor tried to till a boulder again—need a fresh axle or a therapist?
If BNH asks, this whole garage is 'temporarily uncalibrated.' Saves me three hundred credits a week.
Coffee's burnt, treads are bald, and the orbital relay's blinking amber. Standard Tuesday.
Look who crawled out of the spider dome. Bring me anything shiny from the canyon?
Morning, Doc. Park it over the old oil stain. We'll see if it can make a better one.
Got fresh treads and one good battery. The battery's spoken for until I finish this coffee.
Come on in. If the bench wobbles, grab the short leg. It's got the only current calibration sticker in here.
You hear that rattle on the way over? Good. Last time a rover came in quiet, the part was still out in the canyon.
Set your scrap by the vise. If it sticks to the magnet, I'll buy it. If it sticks to me, I'm taking lunch.
I found dirt in your signal booster. Fine dirt, too. You've been somewhere worth charging extra for.
tarantula_silk_reactions: Wait—your cobalt spider spun THAT? Throw away the corporate fiber cable, this stuff doesn't even kink.
I don't do eight legs, friend, but if their silk keeps my torque wrench in spec, I'll knit 'em tiny sweaters.
Careful waving that spool around. If the audit drone scans it, they'll tax your spiders as subcontractors.
Wildest thing I've seen off-world: a fuzzy little bug out-engineering an entire orbital lab.
upgrade_and_audit_hints: Drop a relay post on the north ridge before mining deep—otherwise your phone lag'll drive that drill straight into a cliff.
Bring me six crystal ore and I'll bolt wider treads onto your tractor. Cuts steering drift in half on loose dirt.
Tip for Thursday's audit: zero your hygrometers before noon. The drone always checks the dome first.
When a solar flare hits, park the bots and stay indoors. Saves me welding your bumper back on.

quests.daily_ore_offer: Two ore, if you are out that way.
quests.daily_ore_done: Two ore. So you were out that way.
quests.to_the_click_offer: Your wheel nuts are due, Doc. Bring her into the bay and do them yourself this time. Five nuts, star order. Pull until the wrench clicks, then stop.
quests.to_the_click_done: Five nuts, and the wheel is still on. I have seen worse from people with certificates.
quests.the_gate_key_offer: [PLACEHOLDER] The old colony mine has a gate on the plateau road, and I have the key. I do not hand it to anyone who has not worked rock. Mine two fissures in the tubes and it is yours.
quests.the_gate_key_done: [PLACEHOLDER] Two fissures, clean. Here is the key. The gate on the plateau road is open. The roof in there is old, so bring shoring.
quests.to_the_click_reference: Every one of them right on the click. I checked. I always check. You can keep the wrench.
quests.greenhouse_four_offer: [PLACEHOLDER] You have outgrown that closet you call a lab, Doc. Six hundred credits and four ore buys you a bigger one. I will not do the paperwork, but I will say I told you so.
quests.greenhouse_four_done: [PLACEHOLDER] Bigger walls, same bad coffee. Go on, put a bench in the new space. The next refit is on me.
quests.brams_ore_run_offer: [PLACEHOLDER] Ore does not walk to the rover. Mine five fissures yourself, with your own hands, and I will take ten percent off the next standard I sell you.
quests.brams_ore_run_done: [PLACEHOLDER] Five fissures, and you only complained twice. Ten percent off your next standard. The ore goes in the farm's pile, so we both won.
quests.old_props_offer: [PLACEHOLDER] Those first-drift timbers have been holding on habit since the founding crew left. Buy props at the hub crate and shore two rockfalls down there. Do that and I will square Dana Pike for a day in your lab.
quests.old_props_done: [PLACEHOLDER] Two rooms wedged tight. That roof will outlast the both of us now. Dana Pike has a day on my tab whenever you book her at the console.
quests.colonists_set_offer: [PLACEHOLDER] The first machinists left latched block cases in the side rooms when they pulled out. Most are behind fallen rock. Open three of those cases yourself, Doc, and keep whatever blocks your set is still short.
quests.colonists_set_done: [PLACEHOLDER] Three cases pried open, and good steel back on a bench instead of under rubble. Keep the empty cedar box. The latch still works.

quests.thirsty_probe_offer: Your irrigation thinks the bed is at 40 %. Your turnip disagrees. I trust the turnip.
quests.thirsty_probe_done: Your probe is lying to you. Was. Better.
quests.first_water_offer: Till a cell and plant a seed. The cistern waters planted ground at dawn, so that is all the watering you do.
quests.first_water_done: Soil in, seed in, water on its way. The part that is yours is knowing how wet it really is.
quests.read_the_probe_offer: Click the soil probe in the plot and read what it says. Then ask whether it is right.
quests.read_the_probe_done: That is what it says. Whether it is right is a different question.
quests.first_calibration_offer: Calibrate one instrument at the bench in the dome. Any one. The hygrometer is overdue.
quests.first_calibration_done: One calibration, on the record. I have a job about the soil probe next: The Thirsty Probe.
quests.thirsty_probe_reference: I checked your zero against my own scale. Twice. I found nothing to complain about. I did look.
quests.daily_reeds_done: Three. In spec. I weighed them anyway.

quests.every_sticker_counts_done: One audit with nothing to write down. The stickers on your bench mean something now. Keep them that way.
quests.shuttle_exam_offer: [PLACEHOLDER] The shuttle takes people whose paperwork holds up. One clean calibration at the bench, traceable and on time, by your own hand, and the farm gets its license.
quests.shuttle_exam_done: [PLACEHOLDER] Traceable and on time. The license is the farm's; mind the recall hour on the way back.
quests.on_the_dot_offer: [PLACEHOLDER] Anyone can calibrate. I want to see five instruments calibrated on the day they are due, by your own hand, and none of them a day late.
quests.on_the_dot_done: [PLACEHOLDER] Five on the day. Here is something to keep time by. Do not be late for the next one.
quests.deimos_survey_offer: [PLACEHOLDER] OIRM wants a survey of Deimos, and a survey takes nights. Your permit is in order. Book an expedition at the pad, sleep two nights at the outpost camp, and come home when the shuttle brings you. Leave early and it does not count.
quests.deimos_survey_done: [PLACEHOLDER] Two nights logged and you came home on the shuttle's own schedule. The survey is filed. The permit stands.
quests.a_core_to_certify_offer: [PLACEHOLDER] You have been down into the ice. The layered cores there are worth more than scrap if OIRM puts a stamp on them. Pull one, put it in the cold box, and send it up on the pod.
quests.a_core_to_certify_done: [PLACEHOLDER] Core certified and logged. The stratigraphy is clean and the chain of custody holds. Here is the lab credit and a certificate for your own ledger.
quests.the_sump_sample_offer: [PLACEHOLDER] The water under the Aquifer hub is a sample OIRM would like logged properly, and that takes a night. There is a camp by the pool now. Bring supplies, park the rover beside it, sleep there, and take one find from the depths while you are down. Mind your pack; wet rations spoil.
quests.the_sump_sample_done: [PLACEHOLDER] A night by the sump and a find from below. The log is in order. Here is the lab credit.

quests.first_contract_done: Contract on file. A lab that holds a run of on-time calibrations is a lab we can plan around.
quests.paperwork_from_orbit_offer: Your lab is of a size we take paperwork from. An account opens when you send us a standard you bought.
quests.paperwork_from_orbit_done: Account open, one standard received, one certificate issued. 100 CR is credited toward your next trip.

quests.warmly_dispatch_offer: This is Odalys Brandt at BNH Dispatch. Every message BNH sends you goes through my desk first. Inspector Vance's first audit is on the schedule. Have the stickers on your bench in date when he lands.
quests.warmly_dispatch_clean: Your first audit is on file with nothing in it for me to relay. I had three apology templates ready and have put them back in the drawer. Warmly, Dispatch.
quests.warmly_dispatch_grace: Your first audit is on file. The form says warning, so that is what I filed. Someone sat up with your paperwork so that it would say no more than that, and left a mug on your bench. I am told the ring comes out. I would not hurry. Warmly, Dispatch.
quests.daily_block_offer: Check the rover's steering encoder against a block for me.
quests.daily_block_done: The steering check is on file. Warmly, Dispatch.
quests.a_clean_line_offer: Dispatch again. Your uplink reaches my desk a little late and a little chewed. I am told you have a silk spool on the shelf. Seat it in the relay, and take your time lowering it. The slot is narrower than it looks.
quests.a_clean_line_done: Your line is on my board and it is holding. I have filed the old static under weather. Warmly, Dispatch.
quests.strays_offer: Dispatch. You have been on Phobos. The old station kept tarantulas, and when the station was shut a few were never counted out. They have been living in the warm service tunnel since, and the logbook does not know them. Catch one. I have no paperwork for it and would like to have some.
quests.strays_done: A station tarantula, caught in the tunnel and now in the dome's records. I have filed it as stock, which it was before it was a stray. Warmly, Dispatch.
quests.a_clean_line_reference: That went in dead center. I heard the line clear from here, and I am four hundred kilometers up. Warmly, Dispatch.

quests.certified_in_three_fonts_offer: Chet here. Chet's Calibration, CERTIFIED in three fonts, you have seen the van. One of my customers has a gauge that will not read right however hard I eyeball it. There is an envelope under your airlock. This stays between the two of us.
quests.certified_in_three_fonts_again: The envelope is back under your airlock. The gauge still reads wrong, and I am still not asking anyone else.
quests.certified_in_three_fonts_clean: The customer says it reads right, and on the day, and the paperwork goes all the way up. I checked. I did not know it could do that. The whole envelope is yours, and I owe you one. Tell nobody.
quests.certified_in_three_fonts_sour: Well, it is back. Not when I said it would be, or not with paperwork I can show anyone, and I had to eyeball an excuse for the customer. Half the envelope is yours. We are square.

quests.daily_row_offer: Till me a row by the beacon.
quests.daily_row_done: A straight row. The beacon has something to look at now.
quests.missing_blocks_offer: Those blocks you keep turning up were a set once. Mine. Somebody buried it a piece at a time and I never asked who. Find me three more and we will see what they still add up to.
quests.missing_blocks_done: That is a length, and it holds. The case is yours. It has been empty long enough.
quests.missing_blocks_reference: You wrung that like someone who has done it ten thousand times. I have. I know the look of it.
quests.beacon_run_offer: The tunnels go dark past the first bend. There is a rack by the mouth with my beacons on it. Take one, set it down deeper in, and come back for the next. Three, if you would.
quests.beacon_run_done: Three little lights where there were none. You can find your way home now. So can I, if I ever come down.
quests.two_sunsets_offer: The shaft looks different at dusk and at dawn, and I never stayed to see both. There is a camp by the hub now: a tent, a heater, a bedroll. Bring supplies, park the rover beside it and sleep the night there. Tell me what the rock does.
quests.two_sunsets_done: One night, two sunsets, and you are still in one piece. The rock was kinder than I thought. Mind the supplies next time.
quests.a_night_on_the_ice_offer: [PLACEHOLDER] The ice does not forgive a cold pack. There is a camp by the hub now, with a heater of its own. Buy a cartridge at the crate first, park the rover beside the tent and sleep the night. Then tell me how the ice sounds at night.
quests.a_night_on_the_ice_done: [PLACEHOLDER] You woke warm, which is more than I managed. The ice talks all night, they say. Good work.

hub.rack_take: One beacon, off the rack. Now set it down further in.
hub.rack_holding: You have one in your hand already. Put it down first.
hub.rack_no_job: The beacon run is not open yet. Check back in a moment.
hub.rack_empty: The rack is bare. Every beacon I had is lit somewhere in there.
hub.spot_placed: That one is lit. I can see it from here, or I could if I were there.
hub.spot_needs_beacon: Nothing in your hands. The rack by the mouth has the beacons.

quests.a_quiet_crate_offer: [PLACEHOLDER] So you made it out to Deimos. There is a warm crate on the pad that does not belong to OIRM and does not open for polite knocking. Take my proof, pop the latch, and keep whatever has eight legs inside. No certificate.
quests.a_quiet_crate_done: [PLACEHOLDER] Latch off, stock moved, nobody filed a form. Keep the dome warm for it. We are square.
quests.test_pod_offer: [PLACEHOLDER] Polar ice, huh. There was a trial pod down there, heated, sealed, nobody left to sign it off. Open it once a day, take whatever is breathing inside, and do not ask who paid for it. No certificate. If the cold does not suit you, a standard from me counts as a favour too.
quests.test_pod_done: [PLACEHOLDER] Seal broken, tenant moved, and your name on nothing. Keep it warm. That is the last of my favours for the year.
